definitions.explanation: Accepting defeat or failure with dignity, without excuses or resentment.
Morally clean and straightforward; having integrity.

examples.japanese: {潔|いさぎよ}く⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}めた→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
{潔|いさぎよ}い⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感心|かんしん}した→感心する：21451_kanshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: I was impressed by his dignified attitude.

examples.japanese: {潔|いさぎよ}く⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He resigned with dignity, taking responsibility.

examples.japanese: {潔|いさぎよ}い⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{憧|あこが}れる→憧れる：05302_akogareru⟧。
examples.english: I admire an upright way of living.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{潔|いさぎよ}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧で、⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: He is an upright person who immediately admits when he is wrong.

notes:
WRITING:
The kanji {潔|いさぎよ}い contains ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water) and suggests purity/cleanliness, reflecting the "morally clean" meaning.

FORMS:
- {潔|いさぎよ}く (adverb) - gracefully, with dignity
- {潔|いさぎよ}さ (noun) - dignity, grace
- {潔|いさぎよ}い⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ - dignified attitude

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {潔|いさぎよ}く⟦{負|ま}け→負け：02569_make⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧ - to gracefully accept defeat
- {潔|いさぎよ}く⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}がる→引き下がる：05873_hikisagaru⟧ - to bow out gracefully
- {潔|いさぎよ}い{引|ひ}き{際|ぎわ} - graceful exit/retirement

CULTURAL NOTE:
{潔|いさぎよ}さ is considered a virtue in Japanese culture, related to concepts of honor and dignity. Accepting defeat without excuses is highly respected.
